## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10612 — one family, folded into one card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T13:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10612, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same arms, same probe, same seam: a non-default `ObjectForm` arm skips a per-field gate that the default arm applies. objectui#10612 is the field-level-security half (`applyFieldPermissions`, missing on the tabbed, wizard and split arms). This card is the ADR-0092 D4 managed-object lock (`resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances`, missing on the drawer, modal, tabbed, wizard and split arms).

Under the closure rule (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110) the family is one card with one pin over the six arms. objectui#10612 now carries this card's half, its probe and its reach (UX only: the server write guard refuses the managed write), at `priority:p3` · `security`. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made.
